notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition fund is a governmental column in the funds statement). Receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (p3); roll-forward uses fund balances (beginning 6,556,941, ending 7,355,914 = cash 6,649,061 + cash at county treasurers 706,853, p4 total assets). Balance sheet from the cash-basis net position page (p2); no liabilities printed. Detail: budget-and-actual schedules for General (pp5-8), Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Activities, School Nutrition and Special Building; no per-account activity schedule is printed so the Activities fund schedule is used. General Fund schedule shows no object breakdown so spending lines are 'not itemized' under their program function; header lines with only a budget (2100, 2200, 2300, 2400, 2500, 2600, 2700, 6000 etc.) are skipped. Instruction-function lines (3535, 3551, federal programs 6200-6998) and Employee Benefit 2900 are assigned to instruction because the p3 Instruction total (3,309,051) only ties with them. Transfers: GF transfers out 42,000 = Activities 2,000 + Nutrition 40,000 transfers in (p3); the 8,337 Depreciation to General transfer is internal to the combined General column and nets out. Schedule totals on pp6/8/9/11/12 include the transfer lines (marked includes other financing). Statement of Activities (p1) not recorded as detail.
